\textbf{Justify your answers and show your work.}

\emph{Evaluate each algebraic expression for the given value of the
variable.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $3-4(5+x)^{2},\mbox{ for \ensuremath{x=-6}}$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $\frac{2x+y}{xy-2x}$, for $x=-1$ and $y=4$\vspace{1.5in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Simplify the algebraic expression. Write all exponents as positive. }
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $8-7[-\frac{1}{2}(6-2)+1]$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $\frac{5}{(7-12)^{2}}+\frac{1-3}{5}$\vspace{2.0in}
\item $\left(-\frac{2}{y}\right)^{2}$\vspace{1.0in}
\item $(9x^{4})^{\nicefrac{1}{2}}$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $(x^{5}x^{2})^{-2}$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $(-5x^{4}y)(-6x^{7}y^{11})$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $\frac{8xy^{4}}{16x^{2}y^{-6}}$\vspace{2.25in}
\item $\sqrt{\frac{1}{49}}$\vspace{1.0in}
\end{enumerate}
\newpage{}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $5\sqrt{18}-3\sqrt{2}$\vspace{1.0in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Perform the indicated operation and simplify.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $(x^{5}-7x^{2}+5x)-(-3x^{5}+x^{2}+13)$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $(4x^{2}y-3xy)+(2x^{2}y-xy)$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $(5x-2)(x^{2}+x-3)$\vspace{2.0in}
\item $(7x+2y)^{2}$\vspace{1.5in}\newpage{}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Factor Completely.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $x^{2}+4x-12$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $4x^{3}-8x^{2}$\vspace{1.25in}
\item $5x^{3}+20x^{2}-60x$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $9y^{2}-100$\vspace{1.25in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Factor by grouping.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $x^{3}+6x^{2}-2x-12$.
\end{enumerate}
